notes: State expectations come from games/fuse-box/tests/model.py (upstream rules 1.6.1), not from the emulator. Each panel is solved by switching on its generated target pattern; synthetic-all-panels clears all ten. synthetic-title and synthetic-first-clear require a PCM peak of 21000 (channels F, D and C together). Flip replays leave 600000 cycles for the five-phase flip.
